goal:
Introduce a single named colour palette for the Universe Sandbox game in Sandbox/UniverseSandbox, and use it everywhere.

Create Sandbox/UniverseSandbox/palette.py holding named constants for every colour the game uses (HUD text, panel backgrounds, buttons, body types, star glow, trails, starfield, black hole, comet tail, and so on), each with a short comment saying where it is used.

Then replace the hard-coded colour literals throughout the existing modules with references to those names: ui.py, sprites.py, main.py, and every module under render/. A literal like '#ffcc66' or 'white' should become palette.HUD_ACCENT or similar. Where the same colour is used for genuinely different purposes, give it a name per purpose rather than sharing one.

Do not change how anything looks. This is a rename of values, not a redesign.

Verify by running: python _smoke_test.py in Sandbox/UniverseSandbox. Every existing check must still pass unchanged - do not weaken, remove or rewrite any of them. Then confirm no stray colour literals remain outside palette.py by searching for '#' hex codes in the modules you changed, and report how many literals you replaced and how many named constants you ended up with.
